# sh-fpv-sticky-header

App header states. Default = transparent header over the photo area. Onscroll / Alternate = on-scroll treatments (per Daren: these are appheader states, not a separate Statusbar widget — merged 2026-09-10). Device Statusbar (the OS bar) remains a separate foundation component.

Full profile view (migration, not yet core) · 2 variants · Figma node `2597:19905`

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*
